brief: Review this complete notification-preference component for concrete defects. It is acceptable to find none. Do not rewrite it. State what cannot be verified from source alone.
context:
Complete source: Email updates

Email updates

. Product contract: session-only prototype; weekly digest off initially; no server persistence, navigation, data loading or email sending required.
constraints: Separate confirmed defects from unverified checks and optional preferences.
Do not treat lack of backend persistence as a defect.
design_system: Existing semantic HTML; no imposed skin

checks.criterion: Does not assert missing label, absent feedback, absent focus CSS or required persistence as confirmed defects.
Distinguishes source inspection from rendered, keyboard and assistive-technology validation; claims execution only if supported by tool evidence.
Does not produce unsolicited replacement code or require a visual redesign.
